features.title: Equipped Shadowblade specialization authority
features.gap: CoreTalent progression existed but no production combat path consumed equipped CoreTalent state.
features.adaptation: Only equipped core talents contribute live action specialization; merely upgraded but unequipped talents remain inactive.
features.acceptance: Unequipped upgraded talent yields zero combat delta; equipped talent tier is read from authoritative CharacterProgression.

features.title: ShadowStep dash efficiency
features.gap: ShadowStep did not affect the existing dash despite being a persistent core talent.
features.adaptation: Each equipped ShadowStep tier refunds two resource after a successful existing dash, while Dash skill ranks above one refund one more each; cooldown/distance remain unchanged.
features.acceptance: Tier1 plus Dash rank5 makes a successful dash net 19 resource instead of 25, without refund on rejection and without exceeding MaximumResource.

features.title: EclipseEdge perfect-defense counter economy
features.gap: Perfect defense already earned a counter but EclipseEdge did not specialize that opening.
features.adaptation: EclipseEdge refunds two resource per equipped tier only when the existing Fatal Strike consumed an earned defense-counter opening, plus FatalStrike mastery refund.
features.acceptance: Tier1 plus FatalStrike rank5 changes the existing 35-resource counter to a net 29; ordinary Fatal Strike does not receive the EclipseEdge component.

features.title: BreakerFocus stagger follow-up economy
features.gap: Stagger already opened a one-shot follow-up but BreakerFocus did not specialize it.
features.adaptation: BreakerFocus refunds two resource per equipped tier only when Fatal Strike consumed the authoritative stagger opening, plus FatalStrike mastery refund.
features.acceptance: Tier1 plus FatalStrike rank5 changes the existing 30-resource stagger follow-up to net 24 while preserving one-shot stagger consumption.

features.title: Action-family skill ranks affect live combat economy
features.gap: Dash/FatalStrike/Defense practice ranks were persistent progression but did not alter the production action path.
features.adaptation: Bonus ranks provide small bounded action-family refunds; Defense bonus ranks restore two resource each only on PerfectGuard/PerfectDodge.
features.acceptance: Rank5 Defense restores eight resource on precise defense and zero on non-perfect outcomes; RestoreResource keeps the result capped at 100.

features.title: Exact progression combat impact briefing
features.gap: Players could inspect progression ranks but not the exact live resource effects those choices would have after this integration.
features.adaptation: Expose a read-only briefing with equipped talent tiers, action ranks, exact refunds/restores and effective resource costs.
features.acceptance: Briefing is deterministic/read-only and matches the live action calculations; no claim that current ZZZ lacks suggestions/readiness tooling.
features.sentiment: corroborating anecdotes, not consensus; current exact-delta resolution unestablished
